title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Relief on Northloop Payments Instant Payout Fees
content:
Sellers enrolled in larger Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) programs pay a reduced fee on their Northloop Payments instant payouts.

**Rule.** The fee obtained by applying the instant fee rate once to the payout amount is then multiplied by the fulfillment fee multiplier, which is 0.75 when the seller's FBN enrollment is active in FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program, 0.90 when it is active in FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program, and 1 otherwise; the product is rounded to the cent, and the plan's instant minimum fee is applied last.

## Multiplier by enrollment

| FBN enrollment status | FBN program | Fulfillment fee multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| active | FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program | 0.75 |
| active | FBN Growth Program or FBN Scale Program | 0.90 |
| any other case | — | 1 |

The status and program are read from the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment record. "Any other case" includes an enrollment that is not active and an active enrollment in another FBN program.

## Order within the fee

1. The instant fee rate is applied once to the payout amount.
2. That figure is multiplied by the fulfillment fee multiplier.
3. The product is rounded to the cent.
4. The plan's instant minimum fee is applied last: the fee is never less than it.

*Hypothetical example.* A payout of 2000.00 USD at an instant fee rate of 0.0125 gives 25.00; an active FBN Growth Program enrollment multiplies it by 0.90, giving 22.50 USD, above a 0.50 USD minimum fee. A payout of 40.00 USD at 0.0125 gives 0.50; multiplied by 0.75 for an active FBN Premier Program enrollment it is 0.375, rounded to 0.38 USD, and the 0.50 USD minimum fee applies.
